conditions: The translated OPTIONAL is an evaluated LeftJoin with an empty right-hand multiset. Later filters and solution modifiers are outside the operation.
limitations: The right-hand multiset is empty. An empty group pattern, a nonempty incompatible right side and an error in an optional filter are distinct cases. The claim makes no general assertion about those cases.

triggers: Issuer erratum, changed source representation, or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: A SPARQL 1.1 OPTIONAL pattern whose translated right-hand multiset is empty leaves its input left-hand solution mappings unchanged, including their multiplicities.
